subject: Clearwave activation: admin seed, API keys, invite schedule
messages:
From: Evan Clarke <evan@clearwave.io>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Org activation: Clearwave initial access

Hi Maya,

Thanks for the handoff note from CS — we're ready to kick off access provisioning for Clearwave's first workspace. Procurement loops in next week, but engineering needs the first set of API keys, an admin user for two engineers, and a plan for seeding service accounts. Can you confirm: 

- How do we request the initial API key(s) and which project should they be tied to?
- What is the recommended pattern for admin user invites vs. service account seeding?
- Any blackout windows we should avoid for our onboarding?

Also attaching our internal security contact (Lena Park) for the SOC2 evidence request. Looking for a 2-week runway to full activation if that's feasible.

Thanks,
Evan
Evan Clarke
Head of Platform Engineering | Clearwave Health
ev an@clearwave.io

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Evan Clarke <evan@clearwave.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Org activation: Clearwave initial access

Hi Evan — great to meet you. Short answer: yes, two-week runway is realistic. High-level plan below and I attached the invite-runbook and the keying template for your SREs.

1) Initial project and API keys
- We'll provision a customer workspace project named clearwave-prod-1 (you can request additional projects later).
- We will create one long-lived service API key for the onboarding period (label: onboarding/service-seed) plus two scoped admin API keys for the engineers you mentioned. Keys are created in the console and a copy is posted to the secure channel (we'll rotate after full activation).

2) Admin invites vs service accounts
- Best practice: invite human admins via email invites (RBAC role: Workspace Admin) so they appear in audit logs.
- Seed service accounts via the CSV template (attached) for machine-to-machine keys. We'll perform a canary admin seed first (one admin + one service key) to validate IAM and prefix caching.

3) Invite windows and batching
- We recommend two invite batches: \"canary\" (day 1) and \"bulk\" (day 3) — this prevents invite spam and allows us to confirm provisioning scripts.
- Planned blackout: none scheduled; avoid the weekend of Jun 10–11 if you expect heavy CI runs.

Next steps (action items):
- Evan: confirm engineer emails for admin invites and the SRE who will receive the CSV (Lena included if you want SOC2 visibility).
- Monica: please publish clearwave-prod-1 and seed the first service key; attach canary-admin-checklist output to HubSpot.
- Ben: schedule the 60-minute kickoff (technical) with Clearwave for Monday morning (your calendar).

Attachments: invite-runbook-v0.2.pdf, initial-keying-template.csv

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Clarke <evan@clearwave.io>
Date: Sat, 02 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Org activation: Clearwave initial access

Looping in implementation notes — I ran a quick preflight against Clearwave's requested tenancy. Plan and checklist below (I will attach the canary-admin-checklist when done):

Preflight items (measured):
- Namespace: clearwave-prod-1 created in us-west-2 region.
- Default roles: Workspace Admin, Billing Reader, DevOps Operator created; will map SAML groups per request during full onboarding.
- API key policy: onboarding keys will be scoped to token lifetime 90 days, usage limits 5M tokens/day. We can tighten on go-live.

Canary plan (day 1):
- Seed: create 1 human admin invite (evan.jenkins@clearwave.io) and 1 service account key (service-onboard-001).
- Validate: run sample token flow, ensure KV cache warming is successful, validate logs are emitted to your Splunk endpoint.

Bulk plan (day 3):
- Seed remaining admins (batch of up to 12) using the CSV template.
- Rotate the onboarding service API key and issue production scoped keys.

Security notes:
- We'll place onboarding audit logs in a read-only S3 bucket accessible to Clearwave's security team (Lena).
- If Lena wants the SOC2 artifacts now, we can push the preliminary evidence bundle to the Drive link and flag in HubSpot.

Ben — please send a calendar invite for Monday 2028-06-04 09:00 PT (60m) and include an agenda: kickoff, canary run, role mapping table, and DocuSign review. Evan — confirm the engineer emails and whether CI workers need separate service accounts.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

From: Evan Clarke <evan@clearwave.io>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Park <lena.park@clearwave.io>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Jun 2028 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Org activation: Clearwave initial access

Perfect — thanks for the clear plan. Confirming the two engineers:
- evan.jenkins@clearwave.io (platform lead)
- sara.kim@clearwave.io (infra eng)

CI workers: yes, we will need two service accounts for pipeline runners (we'll fill the CSV and send it back by Monday morning). Lena from procurement/security will handle the SOC2 bundle — she prefers the Drive link you listed.

A couple of quick asks: 
- Can you add a short DocuSign for the onboarding terms (we'll need it for procurement)? I added the procurement contact: lena.park@clearwave.io.
- Please include the S3 read-only path in the evidence bundle (so our security team can snapshot).

We accept the canary/bulk cadence. I'll be on the kickoff Monday.
